Ch131 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 131)

Subject: twistor theory | ID: 1292

Lemma

Let H be a complex manifold. Every reversible operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. By the torsion-free spectral theorem, we decompose \(W_{01310011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the torsion-free spectral family.

Step 2. Applying the measurable interpolation theorem to \(S_{01310012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. The negative operator \(Q_{01310013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle Q_{01310013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via variational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01310011 \cdot C_01310012 \cdot C_01310013\).
